biography:
I'm passionate about deal making, site selection, and economic development and have been in the data center industry since 2014 at Google, Amazon, and Meta.
With over 18 years of experience in real estate and economic development, I have a proven track record of success as a project leader, a team leader and a data center economic development expert.In 2014, I became Amazon's first IC hire in its global Economic Development program and led tax negotiations for data centers, fulfillment centers, corporate offices, and special projects while managing portfolio-wide Economic Development compliance.In 2016, I joined Facebook's infrastructure strategy team as its second Economic Development hire. I negotiated deals in Ohio, Georgia, Alabama, and Virginia to support Facebook's owned first owned data centers in those states, contributed to Policy efforts as a technical economic development expert, and drove innovations in the company's location analysis and tax cost modeling processes.In 2018, I joined Google as its first Economic Development hire to establish a programmatic approach to data center Economic Development. In this role I counseled Google's leaders and site negotiators on Economic Development matters while leading industry association advocacy efforts and negotiations on highly-complex special projects.In 2021, Facebook recruited me back to lead special economic development projects. After completing the special projects, I accepted a senior Site Selection leadership role within the rebranded Meta's infrastructure organization.
